selected_editorial_cases.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5 with lower prices and stronger coding/knowledge-work performance

editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.new_development: A new frontier model was released, and Anthropic paired the launch with a lower price point plus availability across its major distribution channels.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.affected_listener: Developers, enterprise buyers, and teams evaluating whether to switch AI providers or expand usage are directly affected by the new price-performance tradeoff.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.why_today: It is one of the clearest product-level AI moves inside the 48-hour window and answers what changed in the model race, not just what companies said about safety.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.distinct_question: Is the latest Claude release a meaningful step up in value and capability, or just another incremental model refresh?
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.new_since_prior_coverage: New since prior coverage because this is a distinct model launch on September 22, 2026 with specific pricing and availability changes.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.practical_payoff: Buyers can compare Opus 5.5’s lower running cost against other frontier models and watch for whether Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 arrive in the promised coming weeks.
